note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled as library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz and read with fetch_verse_text("owb-am", ref) (founder decision, 2026-11-18: every Amharic work quotes OWB). Every quotation was re-quoted verbatim from it: a whole verse where the English quotes one, otherwise the shortest contiguous OWB span carrying the quoted clause; OWB's own speech marks inside a verse are dropped or nested as ‹ › inside the book's « » quotation.

Rows still marked self_rendered are not quotations of Scripture wording: allusions inside the fifteen men's own words (Murray's "praying without ceasing", Spurgeon's angels with veiled faces, Bounds's "with all perseverance", Finney on Luke 11:13, Graham's "hide the Word in your heart", Blackaby on 1 John 5:14), the book's own image of the altar fire (Leviticus 6:12-13), the prose paraphrase of Hebrews 7:25, and Spurgeon's "It is very good" (Genesis 1:31), which he puts in God's mouth in the present tense where OWB narrates the past (እጅግ መልካም ነበር), so the present-tense ‹እጅግ መልካም ነው› is kept. The Colossians 4:12 row is Murray's own sentence, reused from the-inner-chamber.am.json.
